items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: you'd see Mickey Rooney, or Cary Grant, Art Tatum, Billie Holiday, Jimmy Monroe, Canada Lee, you know, celebrities like that.

ctx.x: we'd go to Jimmy's Chicken Shack up on the hill, or you'd go, you know, places like that.

All right, now. They'd have like...each club would have like a breakfast...not a breakfast dance but a breakfast show they would call it. Or you'd go to Clarke Monroe's Uptown House, or you'd go to...let me see.. Clarke Monroe's Uptown House...I'm trying to think of that boy that was in love with Tallulah Bankhead...what was his name...There were two places that you could go. And if you'd happen to do that you'd see--you'd go to Clarke's Uptown House* you'd see Mickey Rooney, or Cary Grant, Art Tatum, Billie…

On Friday you didn't go to bed. You went straight through from that routine that I told you, from the beginning, but at 8 o'clock you would go to somebody's apartment and drink, or someplace, and wait for the Apollo Theatre to open for the first show, you know, because that first show, Dan, you'd get more. They'd always...they'd have maybe like a couple of acts. After every first show, usually, some act was cut off. A couple of acts. Because it'd be too long...you got to cut this down.....
